sources.observation: The documented built-in C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importers have different entity lists; 3DFACE appears in the legacy list but not the documented C++ list. The documentation says embedded ACIS/SAT solids cannot currently be read. DWG import is converter-to-DXF followed by the selected DXF importer, and converter identity may be LibreDWG, ODA, or QCAD.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Upstream documentation/source establishes route design and documented scope, not current local FreeCAD runtime behavior or libdxfrw correctness.
sources.disposition: For native qualification pin converter, importer backend/build, output DXF version and diagnostics. Do not use FreeCAD importer as an ACIS semantic oracle.

sources.observation: The project documents DWG reading behind WITH_DWG_IMPORT, off by default, through libdxfrw dwgRW; it says DWG writing is not implemented/exposed and is not planned until independent evidence and project decisions reopen the option.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Consumer project policy/documentation on mutable master, not an implementation test or 3D semantic claim for this local checkout.
sources.disposition: Keep the LibreCAD 3 consumer target read/import-directional; do not make DWG writing part of its compatibility requirement or infer 3D display/edit semantics from dwgRW.

sources.observation: The manual distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled classes. Some unsupported class payloads are emitted as UNKNOWN records or downgraded to PLACEHOLDER/DUMMY/POINT, and some raw unknown bits survive only same-version rewrites. Project build flags can omit or enable unstable/unknown-object behavior.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Maintainer-authored mutable manual and build documentation; not independent normative format evidence and not a local reproduction.
sources.disposition: Pin source/binary/configuration and record raw carrier, typed parsing, graphics, and output disposition separately. Restrict peer field comparisons to an explicitly admitted class/configuration subset.

sources.observation: The fuzz setup separates target modes and crash/hang/leak regression replay. Issue #1270 reports a test-harness double-free for a specific 0.13.4.8229 build and says it inflated sanitizer/fuzzer crash counts; it is a version-specific historical harness report.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project fuzz workflow plus one historical issue report; neither establishes a current LibreDWG defect or any libdxfrw defect.
sources.disposition: Keep fuzzing optional/timeboxed at a composed security checkpoint. Pin the harness/mode, sanity-check it under sanitizers, distinguish harness from library crashes, and replay existing crash regressions. No new fuzzer dependency is proposed.

implementationReadiness.localApplicability: Refines PAR-07/S8, PAR-14, PAR-49, PAR-59, PAR-06/PAR-132, and PAR-144. Consumer backend selection, ACIS semantics, peer class coverage, and fuzzer harness health remain separate evidence dimensions.
